pages.title: Panochthus
pages.text: $(o)Panochthus$() ($(o)Panochthus tuberculatus$()) was a large glyptodont, an armoured relative of armadillos, that lived on the grasslands of southern South America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)Its high-domed shell was made of bony plates covered in small bumps, and its tail ended in a long, rigid tube studded along the sides with large bony bosses.$(br2)It probably swung this armoured tail like a mace in fights. It died out about 12,000 years ago.
